title: rhinanthus alectorolophus subsp. modestus
intro: Rhinanthus alectorolophus subsp. modestus, commonly known as Yellow Bartsia or False Foxglove, is a flowering plant species within the family Orobanchaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antispasmodic to alleviate muscle cramps. The therapeutic actions of Rhinanthus alectorolophus subsp. modestus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and potential applications in modern medicine.
